spans.s:
पिडक पिडक, अस्, m. or पिडका, f. a small
boil, pimple, papula, pustule.
—पिडका-वत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, having boils, pimples, &c.
पीडक, अस्, m. an oppressor; [cf. तालु-प्˚.]
पिडकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having boils, &c.

पीड् पीड् (perhaps connected with rt.
पिष्), cl. 1. A. पीडते, पीडितुम्, Ved. to
be squeezed or pressed out (as Soma): Caus. or
cl. 10. P. (ep. also A.) पीडयति (-ते), -यितुम्, to
squeeze, pinch, press, oppress, compress, suppress
(e. g. कालं कालेन पीडयन्, Manu.

, pressing
time against time, or suppressing one period by
means of another, according to Kullūka = सृष्टि-
कालम् प्रलय-कालेन नाशयन्); to overpower;
to hurt, harm, injure, pain, vex, harass, annoy, tor-
ment; to break, violate (an oath); to beleaguer (a
city); to neglect, cause suffering by neglect; to
remove; to cover; (in augury) to cover with any-
thing inauspicious; (in astrology) to eclipse; to
oppose, resist; to stir, agitate.

पीड, अस्, अम्, m. n., in तिल-प्˚, तृण-प्˚, q. v.
—पीड-यन्त्र-गृह, अस्, m. a workhouse for
criminals, house of correction.

पीडा, f. pain, suffering, anguish, annoyance;
damage, injury, wrong; infraction, violation [cf.
धर्म-प्˚]; devastation, laying waste; restriction,
limitation; the ‘pain or calamity’ of a planet,
eclipse, occultation [cf. ग्रह-प्˚]; compassion, pity,
charity; a chaplet, garland for the head; the Saral
tree, Pinus Longifolia; a basket (= पिटक, पेटा,
[]
पेडा).
—पीडा-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, pain-causing, giving
pain, afflicting, tormenting.
—पीडा-करण, अम्, n.
the causing of pain, torturing, tormenting.
—पीडा-
भाज्, क्, क्, क्, (according to Malli-nātha) = विमर्द-
भाज् = भङ्ग-वत्.
—पीडा-स्थान, अम्, n., Ved.
(in astrology) an unlucky position, inauspicious dis-
tance (of a planet).

पीडन, अस्, आ, अम्, molesting, paining, disagree-
able; (अम्), n. the act of pressing, squeezing, rub-
bing; an instrument for pressing, press; oppressing,
inflicting pain, paining, distressing; laying a country
waste, devastation; (in astrology) the oppression or
suppression of a planet &c., i. e. eclipse [cf. ग्रह-
प्˚]; suppressing sounds, a fault in the pronunciation
of vowels.

पीडयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, squeezing, pressing; op-
pressing, suppressing, harassing, paining; breaking,
violating.

पीडाय, Nom. A. पीडायते, -यितुम्, to feel pain,
experience a sense of uneasiness.

पीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, squeezed, pressed; rubbed,
chafed; griped, wrung; oppressed, harassed, dis-
tressed, pained, afflicted, suffering pain or distress,
injured, impaired; violated, transgressed; destroyed,
laid waste, devastated; eclipsed; bound, tied; (अम्),
n. injuring, harming, harassing; a kind of coitus;
(अम्), ind. closely.
—पीडित-ता, f. or पीडित-त्व,
अम्, n. the being squeezed or pressed; the being
afflicted or distressed.

पीड्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being squeezed or pressed;
being pained or afflicted, suffering.

पीडा-भाज्; possessing marks of pressure or wavy
indentations.
